concerns.text: FR-014 requires sampling from posterior distributions (multiple samples per event) to create a point‑estimate dataset that reflects uncertainty. Task T003 draws only a single posterior sample per event, leaving FR‑014 uncovered.

FR-016 mandates correcting for selection bias using detection‑efficiency information. Task T006 applies only a simple detection‑space cut when efficiency curves are unavailable, which does not satisfy the full selection‑bias correction required by FR‑016.

FR-011 specifies hard limits on total runtime (≤ 6 h), peak memory (≤ 7 GB) and disk usage (≤ 20 GB) on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner. No task explicitly measures or enforces these limits; T013 records usage post‑hoc and T014 only checks that a file exists, leaving FR‑011 uncovered.
SC-004 requires measuring computational runtime against the 6‑hour limit. No task performs a runtime measurement or asserts compliance, so this success criterion is not covered.
SC-005 requires measuring peak memory usage against the 7 GB limit. No task records or validates memory consumption, leaving this criterion uncovered.
SC-006 requires measuring peak disk usage against the 20 GB limit. No task captures or validates disk usage, so this success criterion is not covered.
